findings.issue: The bright green color used for the book prices (e.g., '£51.77') has a very low contrast ratio against the white background, failing the WCAG AA minimum contrast threshold of 4.5:1 for body-sized text.

findings.location: Product title links below book covers
findings.issue: Book titles in the catalog grid (e.g., 'A Light in the ...') are aggressively truncated to a single line, hiding key book information and making titles unreadable directly from the gallery view.
The sidebar category links are rendered with default browser bullet points (open circles) that push the text inward, resulting in misaligned left margins compared to the parent 'Books' header.
The light blue text color used for the breadcrumb 'Home' link fails the WCAG AA contrast requirement of 4.5:1 when placed inside the light gray breadcrumb container.
